title: T-031 SQLite vector compatibility
summary: sqlite-vec 0.1.9 passed loading, vector query, backup, restore, fallback, and staging-sample checks.
evidence: All nine compatibility checks passed independently after the builder run.
Backup and restore preserved vector queries.
Missing-extension and bad-path failures were caught safely.
The staging database checksum remained unchanged and the worktree has no remote.
limitations: This spike proves runtime compatibility only. It does not activate vector retrieval in the application.
